Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

eyethinkdata 1.0.0

Documentation

  • Rewrote the help pages for every function, with descriptions, full parameter lists, return values, and examples. resolve.args() now has a help page.

Changes that may affect existing scripts

  • gorilla_eye_processing() is now the Task Builder 2 version (returns td, ed and zd). The previous version, which was the one actually in use, is available as gorilla_eye_processing_old().
  • bulk_file_rename(): prefix is now added to the start of file names and suffix to the end (they were swapped), once per file. It no longer changes the working directory, and will not overwrite an existing file.
  • plotscat(): bayes_factor now works for all plot types, and BF= only appears in the title if it was requested. condcols is now used. Results for group splits are named sigyz1.* and sigyz2.* (sigz.p and sigz.bf are kept for group 1).
  • outp = NULL or "" now means “do not save” in pirateye(), plot_model(), plotscat(), exclorr(), gorilla_eye_plot() and gorilla_iatanalysis().
  • gorilla_q_parse() warns about an unrecognised strip value.

Bug fixes

  • mergey(), exp_pid_merge(), gorilla_q_checkbox(), gorilla_q_performance_engagement() and gorilla_q_rankscore(keepcols = TRUE) no longer fail with an error.
  • gorilla_iatanalysis() and plot_model() no longer leave output diverted to a file after an error.
  • gorilla_q_parse() and gorilla_q_parse_qb2() no longer reuse the previous questionnaire’s table when one has no responses.
  • pirateye(pid_average = TRUE) uses the pid column you name.
  • readin_datalist() works with several folders.
  • gorilla_eye_plot() declares its use of grid and saves the plot it draws.
  • Declared missing dependencies (scales, grid; suggested BayesFactor, clipr, fs, png, rdrop2) and fixed the author field.
